name: StyloPress
author: CodeWS

sections.description:
StyloPress is a versatile WordPress plugin that allows you to easily customize the login page with a unique theme and manage custom color schemes for the WordPress admin panel. This plugin makes it simple to tailor the appearance of your site’s login page and backend for a more personalized experience.

Features

  • Login Page Customizer: Effortlessly design the WordPress login page with real-time previews.
  • Logo Customization: Personalize logos, adjust dimensions, or remove logos entirely.
  • Login Form Settings: Style form backgrounds, borders, padding, shadows, and transparency.
  • Input Elements Settings: Control the look of input fields with customizable borders, colors, and sizes.
  • Button Styles: Design login buttons with custom colors, sizes, shapes, and hover effects.
  • Background Design: Add custom backgrounds, images, videos, or patterns to enhance the login page.
  • Messages Settings: Customize login page messages, including text, background, and border colors.
  • Footer Settings: Customize footer text, font sizes, and label visibility.
  • Google Fonts: Easily customize fonts and host them locally using Google Fonts.
  • Custom CSS/JS Code: Add custom CSS and JavaScript for advanced styling and functionality.
  • 50+ Color Schemes: Access over 50 professionally designed admin color schemes with regular updates.
  • Custom Color Schemes: Create personalized admin color schemes to match your branding.
  • Admin Panel Settings: Manage menu visibility by roles, hide elements, customize the admin footer, and adjust other settings.
  • Custom Widgets: Over 20 custom widgets for the admin dashboard, with free monthly additions.For support and updates, visit our website at: https://codews.online/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the .zip file or search “StyloPress” in ‘Plugins’ screen.
  2. Install and activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
Is StyloPress free to use?

Yes, StyloPress is free to download and use with essential features. You can enjoy powerful customization options at no cost, or upgrade to a premium plan for access to advanced features and regular updates.

Can I create my own admin color schemes with StyloPress?

Yes, StyloPress lets you create custom admin color schemes by selecting colors for menus, buttons, and backgrounds.

Is StyloPress compatible with other plugins?

Yes, StyloPress is compatible with most WordPress plugins. However, we recommend testing it on a development site (Test server or Pre-production site) before using it on a live site to ensure there are no conflicts with other plugins or themes.

How does the subscription module work?

StyloPress operates on a monthly subscription model. Payments are automatically deducted each month as long as your subscription is active. You can cancel anytime, and updates and support are provided throughout your subscription period. Plus, we offer a 100% No-Risk Money Back Guarantee within the first month.
